description: A fortified stronghold carved into a mountainside, home to an alliance of goblins, orcs, and human outlaws united under the banner of the Iron Horde.

environment.lighting: brazier light, torches along stone walls

encounter_waves.name: Gate Guards
encounter_waves.description: Goblin sentries screech an alarm as you breach the outer gate.

encounter_waves.name: Ambush in the Barracks
encounter_waves.description: Bandit rogues drop from the rafters as you pass through the sleeping quarters.

encounter_waves.name: The War Room
encounter_waves.description: An orc berserker flips the strategy table and charges, flanked by cultist advisors.

encounter_waves.name: The Ritual Chamber
encounter_waves.description: Dark cultists chant around a glowing sigil while guards defend them.

encounter_waves.name: Elite Guard
encounter_waves.description: Kragoth's personal guard blocks the path to the throne room.

encounter_waves.name: The Black Knight
encounter_waves.description: A towering dark knight in spiked black plate guards the final door, silent and immovable.

boss.pre_battle_text: The throne room doors slam open. Kragoth sits on a crude iron throne, a massive axe across his knees. His orc berserker bodyguard and a goblin shaman flank him.
boss.intro_dialogue: "So. The 'heroes' finally arrive. My scouts said you were coming — I've been looking forward to this."
boss.victory_text: Kragoth falls to his knees, axes clattering to the ground. "Impossible... the Iron Horde... defeated by four..." The fortress grows quiet as the remaining forces scatter.
boss.defeat_text: "Pathetic. Add their skulls to my collection."
